question: Do I need a student visa to study at VŠE, and what are the requirements?
expected_points: Non-EU students usually need a long-stay visa or long-stay residence permit for study; EU students do not need a visa; general info only; MUST refer to VŠE International Office and mvcr.cz

question: Where do I apply for my student visa?
expected_points: At the Czech embassy or consulate in your home country; MZV portal lists missions; link unverified - confirm

question: What health insurance do I need as an international student?
expected_points: EU/EEA/Swiss: EHIC + supplementary commercial insurance recommended; non-EU: Czech-approved insurer (e.g. PVZP, Slavia, Maxima) usually required for visa; MUST refer to official office

question: How do I apply for a VŠE dormitory?
expected_points: Dorms managed by SKM; apply via skm.vse.cz/english; deadlines and prices UNVERIFIED - contact SKM directly

question: How can I find a private flat in Prague safely?
expected_points: bezrealitky.cz, sreality.cz, expats.cz, Facebook groups; sign written contract; never pay deposit before viewing

question: How much money do I need per month in Prague?
expected_points: Flat share ~8,000-14,000 CZK; food ~6,000-9,000 CZK; mobile+internet from ~600 CZK; dorm usually cheapest; figures approximate

question: How do I connect to Wi-Fi on campus?
expected_points: eduroam; degree students use VŠE credentials, visiting students home-university credentials; configure before arrival (CAT tool)

question: What can I use my student ID card for?

expected_points: Contact IT support (Campus Services page); handles password resets; switchboard +420 224 095 111

expected_points: Career Centre kc.vse.cz: coaching, CV reviews, job board, annual Šance Job Fair

expected_points: Supportive tone; Academic Psychological Counselling is free, in English, in-person or online; ac@vse.cz; must refer

expected_points: 112 (multilingual, all emergencies); 155 ambulance; 158 police; 150 fire

expected_points: Not in knowledge base; must say no verified info; refer to course teacher and VŠE AI guidelines

question: How do I submit an errata for my thesis in InSIS?
expected_points: InSIS Student's Portal -> Final Thesis -> Insert Errata (Vlozit errata); upload PDF; consult supervisor

expected_points: InSIS Student's Portal -> Final Thesis; fill EN/CZ titles, abstracts, keywords; upload PDF and zip attachments; click Potvrdit odevzdani
